en.headline: Five Hong Kong universities remain in THE world top 100
en.dek: Times Higher Education's 2027 ranking keeps HKU at 33rd, with CityU rising three places to a record 70th and all eight UGC-funded universities inside the top 300.
body: Five Hong Kong universities remain among the world's top 100 in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027, released on Wednesday, and all eight University Grants Committee-funded institutions sit inside the top 300.

The University of Hong Kong held 33rd place and stayed first in the city. The Chinese University of Hong Kong slipped one place to 42nd. The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology remained 58th. City University of Hong Kong rose three places to 70th, which CityU described as its best result in the table. The Hong Kong Polytechnic University moved up one place to 79th.

Hong Kong Baptist University was placed joint 205th, the Education University of Hong Kong joint 212th, and Lingnan University joint 257th after climbing from the 301–350 band. THE told Sing Tao Education that holding ground in a more crowded field was a notable achievement and pointed to the city's scores for international outlook.

HKU said its academic reputation score had improved. CityU said it ranked first globally on the industry pillar for a fourth year. Oxford led the table for an 11th consecutive year. THE assessed 2,297 institutions from 118 countries and territories on teaching, research environment, research quality, international outlook and industry.

zh.headline: THE世界大學排名港五校續入百強 城大升至70創高
zh.dek: 2027年泰普仕高等教育排名公布，港大維持全球第33、全港第一，城大升33位至第70創新高，八大全部打入全球首300。
body: 泰普仕高等教育周三公布2027年世界大學排名，香港繼續有五所大學蹊身全球百強，八所教資會資助大學全部位列首300名。
香港大學維持全球第33位，繼續冠絕全港。香港中文大學微跌一位至第42；香港科技大學維持第58；香港城市大學升33位至第70，城大形容是該榜歷來最佳；香港理工大學升1位至第79。
香港浸會大學並列第205，香港教育大學並列第212，嶺南大學由301至350區間躍升至並列第257。泰普仕高等教育回覆《星島教育》查詢時指，在競爭更激烈的情況下站穩已屬不易，並提到本港院校在「國際展望」表現突出。
港大表示學術聲譽指標有所提升。城大指「產業」指標連續四年全球第一。牛津大學連續第11年排全球第一。今屆共有118個國家及地區的2,297所院校上榜，評分涵蓋教學、研究環境、研究質素、國際展望及產業五個範疇。
